title: An Act to Provide Financing Assistance for Down Payments for First-generation Homeowners

summary.text: This bill establishes a program to be administered by the Maine State Housing 2106 Authority that provides down payment assistance in the form of loans to prospective first- 2117 generation homeowners with household incomes at or below 100% of the area median 2128 income where the property to be purchased is located. Loans issued under the program 2139 may not exceed 10% of the purchase price of the property and administrative costs may not exceed $3,200 per loan. The bill provides ongoing funding of $10,000,000 per year to administer the program.
